And honestly, this release is an absolute game changer!!! Our users can stop worrying about file chaos and get on with real work. If your team is tired of chasing attachments, duplicated folders and “final-final” files, Northbeam Sync gives you a clearer way to stay aligned across devices.

See what a calmer file workflow can look like with Northbeam Sync.

expected.why: Exclamation-mark hype in a B2B marketing post conflicts with the requirement for professional, plain language.

expected.quote: this release is an absolute game changer!!!
expected.why: The phrase uses promotional hype and repeated exclamation marks instead of professional, plain B2B language.
Marketing copy should speak to the customer as "you" and avoid referring to customers as "users".

content:
Subject: A simpler way to keep files aligned

Northbeam Sync helps teams keep files in step across devices. It is used by teams in 14 countries, and its 99.9% monthly uptime is backed by our SLA.

For our users, the value is straightforward: fewer moments spent wondering which copy is current and more confidence that work is available where it is needed. Our users can also rely on files being encrypted at rest with AES-256.

If you are reviewing file workflows this quarter, we would be glad to show how Northbeam Sync fits into a typical team setup. Reply to this email and we can arrange a short product walkthrough.

expected.why: The copy refers to customers as "users" instead of speaking to them as "you" or "your team".
The second use of "users" repeats the same customer-address issue in marketing copy.

content:
When work moves between a laptop, desktop and shared workspace, the hard part is often not creating a file. It is knowing that everyone is working from the right version.

Northbeam Sync is designed to keep your files in step across devices. That gives your team a simpler way to move between locations without adding another manual check to the day. The service is used by teams in 14 countries, and its 99.9% monthly uptime is backed by our SLA.

Files are also encrypted at rest with AES-256. Together, these capabilities support a practical workflow: your team can focus on the work itself while Northbeam Sync helps keep shared files aligned across devices.

Stop babysitting files. Northbeam Sync keeps your files in step across devices, so your team can pick up work without hunting through duplicate folders or old attachments.

It is stupidly simple to get moving, and the experience is a total no-brainer for busy teams. Northbeam Sync is 10x faster than ordinary sync tools, giving you instant access wherever work happens. Files are encrypted at rest with AES-256, and service availability is backed by our 99.9% monthly uptime SLA.

Your team gets a cleaner way to stay aligned across devices, with less time spent asking which version is current. Bring your files together with Northbeam Sync and get back to the work that matters.

expected.quote: It is stupidly simple to get moving, and the experience is a total no-brainer for busy teams.
